title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
layout_note: One time step of a recurrence unrolled left to right: four parallel state lanes run across the top band from the previous state h_{t-1} (far left) through the A column to the next state h_t (far right); the per-step input x_t, the parameter columns B_t, Delta_t, C_t and the output y_t hang in a lower band, wired into the lanes by elbow lines.
grouping: No containers or panels. Grouping is by colour family alone: orange for the hidden state (stacked state sheets and every state lane), green for vectors and parameters (x_t, B_t, A, C_t, Delta_t, y_t), blue for the input-dependent projection and its arrows. A small two-band triangle in the bottom-right corner (orange GPU SRAM over green GPU HBM) acts as a key that maps the same two colours to memory levels.
shapes_depth: Flat rectangles with thin dark outlines and pale fills, no shadows. Vectors are drawn as tall narrow pale-green columns; x_t and y_t are columns of square cells with only the first cell filled; each hidden state is a stack of offset orange-outlined sheets to show several channels. Lines are thin and elbow-routed with rounded corners; one dashed arrow labelled 'Discretize' and dashed lines fanning x_t into the Project box. Large italic math variables label every element.
proposed_highlight: The new selection mechanism is the only blue element: a small 'Project' box and three thicker blue arrows from it into B_t, Delta_t and C_t, with a bold blue 'Selection Mechanism' label running along the arrow bundle. Everything else stays orange or green.
lesson: Reserve one hue for the contribution and use it nowhere else: here a single blue box plus its blue arrow bundle, labelled once along the bundle, sits under an orange/green recurrence, so the eye finds the new mechanism without any container.
notes: 'other' element = the stacked-sheet hidden states and the corner triangle used as a colour-to-memory key. Venue: the PDF and Semantic Scholar give only arXiv; the published venue (COLM 2024, remembered) is unverified. Year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: One unrolled recurrence step with no containers: four parallel orange state lanes span the top band from the stacked h_{t-1} sheets at far left through the A column (top centre) to h_t at far right, while x_t, B_t, Delta_t, C_t and y_t hang as green columns in a lower band.
insights.data: Vectors are tall pale-green columns (x_t and y_t as columns of square cells with only the top cell filled), each hidden state is a stack of offset orange sheets to show channels, and every element carries a large italic math symbol.
insights.emphasis: The selection mechanism is the only blue in the figure: a small 'Project' box plus three thick blue arrows into B_t, Delta_t and C_t, labelled once in bold blue 'Selection Mechanism' along the bundle.
insights.flow: State flows left to right along the straight orange lanes; the lower band feeds in by elbow-routed lines rising from B_t into the lanes before A and dropping from the lanes into C_t after A, with dashed fan lines from x_t into Project and a dashed 'Discretize' arrow from Delta_t.
insights.avoid: The GPU SRAM/HBM triangle in the bottom-right corner encodes memory levels only by colour reuse and is easily mistaken for part of the computation; the dense orange elbow crossings around A are hard to trace individually.

arrangement.units: no enclosed regions; a top band of state lanes and a lower band of parameter columns, separated only by position and colour
arrangement.inputs_as: x_t as a cell column at lower left and h_{t-1} as stacked sheets at upper left
